visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short black hair and glasses, wearing a black sweatshirt, holds a large cardboard box labeled 'DIY GROW YOUR OWN MUSHROOM KIT' inside a warehouse-style store with orange steel shelving and stacked pallets in the background. (2) Close-up of the box opening reveals two large white substrate bags with labels 'Blue Oyster' and 'Coral Mushroom'. (3) The man, now wearing a conical straw hat and a camouflage cloak, stands on an outdoor porch, using a blue spray bottle to mist the grow bags placed on a metal shelf. (4) Looking through a glass window into a house, large grey mushrooms are seen sprouting significantly from the bags placed on a counter. (5) In a brightly lit home interior, the man excitedly shows the mushroom-covered bag to a small boy and a young girl sitting at a dining table. (6) An older man sitting at the table inspects the mushrooms while the younger man points to the thick growth. (7) Hands use tongs to melt a block of yellow butter on a black electric griddle, followed by adding sliced pork, crushed garlic, and a large quantity of harvested grey mushrooms. (8) A young woman with long dark hair and the older man taste the cooked mushrooms with chopsticks, showing surprised and delighted facial expressions. (9) The man laughs at the camera while the little girl eats from her bowl in the background. (10) The older man talks directly to the camera while holding a piece of mushroom with his chopsticks, appearing impressed. (11) Close-up shot showing vibrant yellow and grey mushrooms fully matured on the bags outdoors.
